relations.subject: Rahul Peter Das
relations.evidence: Rahul Peter Das (born 7 July 1954 in Haan, North Rhine-Westphalia)... is a former professor of South Asian studies (Südasienkunde) at the Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg

relations.subject: Rahul Peter Das
relations.evidence: He returned to Germany in 1974, where he studied Indology, Islamic studies and Tamilology at the University of Cologne and the University of Hamburg

relations.subject: Rahul Peter Das
relations.evidence: he studied Indology, Islamic studies and Tamilology at the University of Cologne and the University of Hamburg, obtaining all his degrees from the latter.
